description: Use when an agent needs a cross-market snapshot in one $0.10 USDC call: grouped headlines across up to 8 markets, optional per-coin slices (up to 10 tickers), recent Binance listing alerts, and tracked coin prices. A grouped multi-market signal brief (crypto, stocks, forex, commodities, macro), optional per-coin slices, recent Binance listing alerts and tracked coin snapshot: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: markets: optional 1-8 comma-separated market labels; coins: optional 1-10 comma-separated tickers; limit_per_slice: 1-25 per slice, default 10; relevant: optional true; since: optional UTC timestamp ending Z; format: compact or omit for full fields. Costs $0.1 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

coins.description: Optional comma-separated tickers (1 to 10, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL,DOGE,XRP) for per-coin headline slices alongside the market buckets.

first_in_group.description: Optional true: keep records explicitly marked repeat_first=true. Missing flags are excluded; groups are source-defined and do not guarantee unique real-world events. Omit to retain all observations.

format.description: Optional compact view: retain selected headline or market fields and omit other fields. Omit for the full response.

limit_per_slice.description: Maximum headlines returned per market, coin or listings slice, 1 to 25. Default 10.

markets.description: Optional comma-separated market labels (1 to 8 from crypto, equities, forex, commodities, rates, macro, energy, real_estate). Default crypto,equities,forex,commodities,macro.

relevant.description: Optional: true keeps only market-relevant records: a market, ticker, crypto asset, exchange or event label, a Binance announcement, or an AI score away from neutral (positive or negative). Drops general news such as sport and politics without market content.

since.description: Optional UTC time such as 2026-11-13T09:00:00Z: only records first seen after it, so a bot polling every hour pays for new items only.

name: get_market_signal_batch
title: Pay: Multi-market signal batch ($0.10)
